structural damage: After the earthquake, engineers checked the old school building for structural damage before letting students back inside.
地震過後，工程師先檢查老舊校舍是否有結構性損壞，才讓學生回到裡面。
structural changes: The company made structural changes, combining three departments into one and changing who reports to whom.
公司進行了結構性變革，把三個部門合併為一個，並改變了彼此的上下屬關係。
structural unemployment: As factories use more robots, structural unemployment rises because many workers lack the skills for new jobs.
隨著工廠使用更多機器人，結構性失業增加，因為許多工人缺乏新工作所需的技能。
structural reform: The new government promised structural reform of the tax system instead of just making small changes each year.
新政府承諾對稅制進行結構改革，而不只是每年做些小調整。
a stubborn stain: I spilled coffee on my white shirt, and it left a stubborn stain that would not come out after three washes.
我把咖啡灑在白襯衫上，留下了一塊洗了三次都洗不掉的頑固污漬。
a stubborn problem: Traffic jams near the train station have been a stubborn problem that the city has failed to solve for years.
火車站附近的塞車一直是市政府多年來都無法解決的頑固難解的問題。
stubborn resistance: Despite weeks of attacks, the soldiers in the castle put up stubborn resistance and refused to give up.
儘管遭受數週的攻擊，城堡裡的士兵仍頑強抵抗，拒絕投降。
a stubborn cold: I have had a stubborn cold for three weeks; no matter how much medicine I take, I keep coughing.
我得了一場拖了三週、久治不癒的感冒；不管吃多少藥，我還是一直咳嗽。
as stubborn as a mule: My brother is as stubborn as a mule; once he decides something, nobody can change his mind.
我哥哥固執得像頭驢；他一旦決定了什麼事，沒有人能改變他的想法。
a sturdy pair of boots: Before hiking on the rocky mountain trail, you should buy a sturdy pair of boots that won't fall apart.
在崎嶇的山路上健行之前，你應該買一雙不會壞掉的結實靴子。
sturdy resistance: The small village showed sturdy resistance to the plan to build a factory, holding protests every weekend for a year.
這個小村莊對興建工廠的計畫展現了堅定的抵抗，一整年每個週末都舉行抗議。
a sturdy defense: Our basketball team won because of a sturdy defense that allowed the other team to score only forty points.
我們籃球隊獲勝是因為堅實的防守，只讓對手得到四十分。
sturdy independence: Living alone in a foreign country taught Emma a sturdy independence; she now solves her problems by herself.
獨自在國外生活讓艾瑪學會了堅定的獨立性；她現在都自己解決問題。
a submarine cable: When a ship damaged a submarine cable near Matsu, people on the island lost their internet connection for weeks.
一艘船損壞了馬祖附近的海底電纜，島上的居民有好幾週無法上網。
submarine volcanoes: Scientists use robots to study submarine volcanoes, which erupt deep under the ocean where people cannot go.
科學家利用機器人研究海底火山，它們在人類無法到達的深海底下噴發。
a nuclear submarine: A nuclear submarine can stay underwater for months because it does not need to come up for fuel.
核子潛艇可以在水下停留數個月，因為它不需要浮上來補充燃料。
subsequent events: The first report about the fire was wrong, and subsequent events showed that it was caused by a broken heater.
關於火災的第一份報導是錯的，隨後發生的事件顯示起火原因是一台故障的暖氣。
in subsequent years: The museum had few visitors when it opened, but in subsequent years it became one of the city's top attractions.
這座博物館剛開幕時參觀者很少，但在隨後的幾年裡成了城市最熱門的景點之一。
subsequent to: Subsequent to the opening speech, the guests were invited to walk into the garden and enjoy dinner together.
在開幕致詞之後，賓客們受邀走進花園一起享用晚餐。
subsequent generations: The old farmer planted trees on the hill so that subsequent generations could enjoy the shade and the fruit.
老農夫在山坡上種樹，好讓後代能享受樹蔭和果實。
a substantial amount: Building the new sports center cost a substantial amount of money, so the city had to raise taxes.
興建新運動中心花了大量的錢，所以市政府不得不加稅。
substantial evidence: The police found substantial evidence, including videos and fingerprints, that the man had broken into the shop.
警方找到了大量證據，包括影片和指紋，證明那名男子闖入了商店。
a substantial meal: Before the long bike ride, we ate a substantial meal of rice, meat, and vegetables to give us energy.
在長途單車騎乘之前，我們吃了一頓有飯、有肉、有蔬菜的豐盛的一餐來補充體力。
substantial changes: After students complained, the school made substantial changes to the lunch menu, adding more fresh fruit and vegetables.
在學生抱怨之後，學校對午餐菜單做了重大變化，增加了更多新鮮水果和蔬菜。
a substantial increase: There has been a substantial increase in the number of tourists since the new high-speed rail station opened.
自從新的高鐵站啟用後，遊客人數大幅增加。
substantial progress: Both sides made substantial progress in the talks and are close to signing an agreement next month.
雙方在談判中取得了實質進展，下個月就快要簽署協議了。
a subtle difference: Only a trained ear can detect a subtle difference between the two violins, which look almost exactly the same.
只有受過訓練的耳朵才聽得出這兩把外觀幾乎一模一樣的小提琴之間微妙的差異。
a subtle hint: Instead of asking directly, Mom gave a subtle hint by leaving the vacuum cleaner outside my bedroom door.
媽媽沒有直接開口，而是把吸塵器放在我房門外，給了我一個含蓄的暗示。
subtle changes: If you look at old photos, you can notice subtle changes in your face that are hard to see day by day.
如果你看看舊照片，就能注意到臉上那些每天很難察覺的細微的變化。
a subtle flavor: This green tea has a subtle flavor, so you should not add sugar or milk that would cover its light taste.
這款綠茶味道清淡細緻，所以你不該加會蓋過它淡雅口感的糖或牛奶。
subtle humor: The novel is full of subtle humor, so you may only notice the jokes when you read it a second time.
這本小說充滿含蓄的幽默，所以你可能要讀第二遍才會發現其中的笑點。
a subtle approach: Instead of criticizing her friend directly, Mia took a subtle approach and quietly suggested a few small changes.
米亞沒有直接批評朋友，而是採取巧妙委婉的做法，悄悄地建議了幾個小改變。
